newsitem.title: USA: Perkins Family to reduce distributions.
newsitem.headline: Perkins Family to reduce distributions.

text.p: Perkins Family Restaurants LP said Monday that it plans to reduce or eliminate its cash distributions as a result of a change in federal income tax law that will require most publicly traded limited partnerships to be taxed as a corporation beginning January 1, 1998.

The company said that it is now advising partners that with the requirement of tax payments beginning in 1998, it plans to reduce the cash distributions by at least the amount of the taxes and perhaps even eliminate the distributions.
